div.div: AIOLIA, an EU-funded research project at THWS

div.span: retrieved passages reranked down to the sources each answer cites

ul.li: Self-hosted chatbot that teaches AI ethics and the EU AI Act, on LangGraph and FastAPI, with a game-style Node.js front end.
Hybrid search (dense + BM25), with Presidio and NeMo Guardrails masking personal data and screening prompt injection.
